## File: facebookresearch_d2go/d2go/optimizer/build.py

Prompts

```
['build an optimizer from config using build_optimizer_mapper with a PyTorch model and d2go config', 'get optimizer parameter groups for a model with learning rate and weight decay settings from config', 'register a new optimizer builder function in the D2GO_OPTIM_MAPPER_REGISTRY for custom optimizer support', 'add full model gradient clipping to an optimizer by wrapping it with maybe_add_gradient_clipping', 'get learning rate parameter groups for a model with bias lr factor and lr multiplier overwrite settings']
```

```
{'build_optimizer': 'build an optimizer from config using build_optimizer_mapper with a PyTorch model and d2go config', 'get_param_groups': 'get optimizer parameter groups for a model with learning rate and weight decay settings from config', 'register_optimizer_mapper': 'register a new optimizer builder function in the D2GO_OPTIM_MAPPER_REGISTRY for custom optimizer support', 'add_gradient_clipping': 'add full model gradient clipping to an optimizer by wrapping it with maybe_add_gradient_clipping', 'get_lr_param_groups': 'get learning rate parameter groups for a model with bias lr factor and lr multiplier overwrite settings'}
```
